content:
[Verse 1]
[A]Hark! the herald
angels sing,
"Glory [D]to the
[E]new born [A]King,
[A]Peace on earth, and
mercy mild,
[E]God and sinners
[E][B]reconciled!"
[E]Joyful, all ye
nations rise,
Join the triumph
of the skies;
[D]With the angelic
[Bm]host proclaim,
[E]"Christ is [A]born in
[A][E]Bethlehem!"
[D]Hark! the herald
[Bm]angels sing,
[E]"Glory [A]to the
[E]new born [A]King!"

[Verse 2]
[A]Christ, by highest
heaven adored;
Christ, the [D]ever-
[E]lasting [A]Lord;
[A]Late in time be-
hold him come,
[E]Offspring of a
[B]virgin's [E]womb.
[E]Veiled in flesh the
Godhead see;
Hail the incar-
nate Deity,
[D]Pleased as man with
[Bm]man to dwell,
[E]Jesus, [A]our Em-
[A][E]manuel.
[D]Hark! the herald
[Bm]angels sing,
[E]"Glory [A]to the
[E]new born [A]King!"

[Verse 3]
[A]Hail the heaven-born
Prince of Peace!
Hail the [D]Sun of
[A][E]Righteousness!
[A]Light and life to
all he brings,
[E]Risen with healing
[B]in his [E]wings.
[E]Mild he lays his
glory by,
Born that man no
more may die,
[D]Born to raise the
[Bm]sons of earth,
[E]Born to [A]give them
[E]second [A]birth.
[D]Hark! the herald
[Bm]angels sing,
[E]"Glory [A]to the
[E]new born [A]King!"

[Verse 4]
[A]Come, Desire of
nations, come,
Fix in [D]us thy
[E]humble [A]home;
[A]Rise, the woman's
conquering Seed,
[E]Bruise in us the
[B]serpent's [E]head.
[E]Adam's likeness,
Lord, efface;
Stamp thine image
in its place.
[D]Second Adam
[Bm]from above,
[A][E]Reinstate us
[E]in thy [A]love.
[D]Hark! the herald
[Bm]angels sing,
[E]"Glory [A]to the
[E]new born [A]King!"

tuning: E A D G B E
